title: sepsis-ards-shared-hub-genes: code, derived results, and data inventory for the sepsis/ARDS shared hub-gene study
description: Analysis code, derived results, and the complete input inventory for the shared hub-gene and immune-signature study of sepsis and ARDS (Supplementary Methods S1-S14). Contains 217 analysis scripts driven by run_all.sh (17 stages), 369 derived result files, the manuscript text and all 27 supplementary tables as submitted, plus DATA_INVENTORY.md/csv (accession numbers, platforms, versions, and access dates for every public input), FETCH_PUBLIC_DATA.md (retrieval runbook), and environment/tool_versions.txt. Raw public data are not redistributed: all inputs are third-party resources re-downloadable from GEO, IEU OpenGWAS, FinnGen, eQTLGen, HPA, PDB, ChEMBL, and Open Targets.
notes: Secondary analysis of public data. Corresponding author: Dansen Wu (wds_9201851126@fjmu.edu.cn), Fuzhou University Affiliated Provincial Hospital, Fuzhou, China.
